predecessors.name: Western Turkic Khaganate (Western Göktürks)
predecessors.text: the Khazar country north of the Caucasus, a client of the Western Turks until the murder of Tong Yabghu c.

successors.name: Kievan Rus'
successors.text: Sarkel on the lower Don, Belaya Vyezha

successors.name: Pechenegs
successors.text: the steppes of southeast Europe that the Pechenegs 'controlled' in the 9th and 10th centuries

ledger.x: 630: the Khazars stand on the Caspian gate.
630: the Derbent country (Dagestan) passes from the Western Turks.
642: the Arabs reach the Caspian gate.
647: 114 cells (about 28,800 km2, 96 of them in the Kazakh Steppe) pass from the Western Göktürks to Khazaria in Cliopatria's shapes.
647: the lower Volga and the Ural-Aral steppe join the Khazar country.
652: the Khazars hold the Caspian gate.
668: the Khazars break Old Great Bulgaria.
682: a further 136 cells of the Pontic and Volga steppe.
722: the Second Arab-Khazar War reaches the Caspian gate.
750: the capital moves to Atil on the Volga delta.

c. 890: the Volga Bulgars as Khazar vassals. The Volga Bulgaria infobox: 'Vassals of the Khazars (late 9th century-969)'; the article says the Bulgars 'came under the overlordship of Khazars' without a year; the Khazars page calls the Volga Bulgarians a 'protectorate'. 890 is the researcher's mid-point of 'late 9th…
965: Sviatoslav destroys Sarkel. he destroyed it 'around 965' and set up a Rus' settlement called Belaya Vyezha; Khazars page: 'Sarkel fell in 965'.
969: the Volga Bulgars cease to be Khazar vassals.
969: Sviatoslav sacks Atil and the Khazar khaganate ends.

wars.name: First Arab-Khazar War
wars.outcome: The Arabs take Derbent in 642; the Khazars crush an Arab army at Balanjar in 652 and the Arabs fall back to Derbent; hostilities pause until the early 8th century.

wars.name: Khazar conquest of Old Great Bulgaria
wars.outcome: Old Great Bulgaria disintegrates under Khazar attack (668); the Bulgars scatter: Batbayan subject to the Khazars, Kotrag north on the Volga, Asparukh west to the Danube delta.

wars.name: Second Arab-Khazar War
wars.outcome: The Arabs hold Derbent, Albania and Iberia (Tiflis 724) and end at Derbent 'the northernmost outpost of the Muslim world', leaving the North Caucasus to the Khazars; Marwan's 737 invasion drives the khagan towards the Urals; Byzantine-Khazar alliance sealed…

wars.name: Khazar raids on Transcaucasia
wars.outcome: A raid by Ras Tarkhan after the failed Abbasid marriage alliance; no ground held.

wars.name: Khazar raids of 799
wars.outcome: A series of Khazar raids breaks the relations between the Khazars and the Abbasids; no ground held or lost.

wars.name: Pecheneg and Oghuz wars
wars.outcome: The Oghuz defeat the Pechenegs near the Aral Sea before 850; the Khazars ally with the Oghuz against them; the Pechenegs settle on the Donets and Kuban and by 889-892 drive the Magyars west of the Dnieper.

wars.name: Sviatoslav's campaign against the Khazars
wars.outcome: Rus' victory: Vyatichi made tributary to Kiev (966), Sarkel destroyed around 965, Atil sacked 968 or 969; no permanent Rus' occupation of the heartland.

certainty.note: Steppe and mountain frontiers throughout; the only fixed line is the Arab-held fortress of Derbent from 737 ('the northernmost outpost of the Muslim world'), a fortress and not a surveyed border.
